title: Elixir of Battlemage's Power
summary: Gain Arcane Acuity until Long Rest.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Gain Arcane Acuity until Long Rest.
fields.Stacking: Replaces other normal elixirs and can be overwritten by another.
fields.Crafting: Combine Suspension of Gauth Eye with any Sublimate.
fields.Arcane Acuity: Gain +1 to spell attack rolls and save DC per remaining turn. Each damaging hit removes two turns. In combat the elixir applies 3 turns at the start of turn and ordinary decay immediately leaves 2. If damage removes all remaining turns, the source reports 3 turns are immediately reapplied.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
